N09#1.zh: 正是严冬天气，彤云密布，朔风渐起，那雪正下得紧。
N09#1.t: It was deep winter. Dark clouds massed, the north wind rose, and the snow fell thick and fast.

N09#2.zh: 草料场的草厅年久失修，四下漏风。林冲与众好汉一道出外采买修屋的材料，顺带沽些酒食御寒。归来时，却见草堆间火光冲天，风卷烈焰，已不是寻常失火的模样。
N09#2.t: The depot's hut was old and let the wind in on every side. Lin Chong and the heroes had gone out to buy materials to fix it and some wine against the cold. When they came back, flames were leaping between the hay stacks, the wind whipping the fire. It looked like no ordinary accident.

N09#3.zh: 不好！草料场怎么已经烧起来了？我们才去市集买修屋的材料和酒食，来回不过这点工夫！
N09#3.t: Oh no! How is the depot already on fire? We only went to market for materials and food. We weren't gone long at all!

N09#4.zh: 林教头，先别冲过去！那边有三个人走来，咱们且借山神庙旁的暗处藏身，听听动静。
N09#4.t: Instructor Lin, don't rush in yet! Three men are coming this way. Let's hide in the shadows by the mountain shrine and listen.

N09#5.zh: （低声）我出门前盖好了火盆，门也锁妥了。这样大的火，难道有人故意纵的？
N09#5.t: (Quietly) I covered the brazier and locked the door before I left. A fire this big... could someone have set it on purpose?

N09#6.zh: 这火势好！我在四下草堆点了十来处火，任他林冲有天大的本事，也无处躲藏！
N09#6.t: What a blaze! I lit a dozen fires around the hay stacks. However great Lin Chong's skill, he's got nowhere to hide!

N09#7.zh: （低声）是洪教头的声音……诸位暂且忍耐，莫惊动他们。
N09#7.t: (Quietly) That's Instructor Hong's voice... Bear with it for now, everyone. Don't alert them.

N09#8.zh: 先前听说柴进替他安排了这份差事，我也只是记在心里。谁想今日倒成了结果他性命的所在！
N09#8.t: When I heard Chai Jin had got him this post, I just kept it in mind. Who'd have thought it would become the place he dies!

N09#9.zh: （暗想）原来他们早就盯上了我，却等到此时才下手……
N09#9.t: (Thinking) So they've been watching me all along, waiting until now to strike...

N09#10.zh: 端的亏你用心！管营、差拨那边已经打点妥当。回到京师禀过太尉，自有你们的好处。
N09#10.t: You really put your heart into this! The warden and the warder have been taken care of. When we're back in the capital and report to the Marshal, you'll be rewarded.

N09#11.zh: 便逃得性命时，烧了大军草料场，也得个死罪！咱们再看一看，休叫他脱了身。
N09#11.t: Even if he escapes with his life, burning the army's fodder depot is a capital crime! Let's take another look; don't let him get away.

N09#12.zh: （低声）陆谦，富安……竟又是这两个！
N09#12.t: (Quietly) Lu Qian, Fu An... these two again!

N09#13.zh: 再等火烧透了，拾得他两块骨头回京，也好在太尉和衙内面前交差。林冲一死，衙内那桩心事便了了！
N09#13.t: Once the fire burns through, we'll pick up a couple of his bones to take back, so we can report to the Marshal and the young master. With Lin Chong dead, the young master's wish will be settled!

N09#14.zh: 林冲伏在暗处，将三人的话听得明白。他轻轻掇开挡路的大石，挺着花枪，大喝一声——
N09#14.t: Lin Chong, hidden in the dark, heard every word. He quietly moved aside the stone blocking the way, levelled his spear, and gave a great shout—

N09#15.t: Where do you think you're going, villains!

N09#16.zh: 三人站在远处看火，听得这一声，惊得呆了，一时间竟动弹不得。
N09#16.t: The three, watching the fire from a distance, froze at the shout, unable to move.

N09#17.zh: 泼贼！你们竟放火害我，还要拿失守草料场的罪名断我的活路！今日不杀你们，林冲还有甚么活路！
N09#17.t: Villains! You set a fire to kill me, and then mean to finish me off with the crime of losing the depot! If I don't kill you today, what way out is left for me!

N09#18.zh: 林冲？！你竟不在草料场里！方才的话……都叫你听去了？
N09#18.t: Lin Chong?! You weren't in the depot! What we just said... you heard all of it?

N09#19.zh: 陆虞候，他身后还有人！快叫弟兄们围住，莫让他们走脱！
N09#19.t: Captain Lu, there are others behind him! Quick, have the men surround them, don't let them get away!

N09#20.zh: 林教头，且慢动手！我也是奉命行事，你我旧日的交情，何必闹到这般田地？
N09#20.t: Instructor Lin, hold on! I was only following orders. For the sake of our old friendship, why let it come to this?

N09#21.zh: 陆谦！我只道你是故交，谁知你一回回要置我于死地！如今毒计败露，还敢来攀旧日情分！
N09#21.t: Lu Qian! I thought you were an old friend, yet time after time you try to kill me! Now your plot is exposed and you dare bring up old friendship!

N09#22.zh: 既把话说破，便留你不得！众人一起上，休叫一个走了！
N09#22.t: Now that it's all out, you can't be left alive! Everyone at once, don't let a single one escape!

N09#23.zh: 三人回过神来，见前门被堵，各自往草料场深处逃去，要从后门、侧门溜走。陆谦吓得慌了手脚，走也走不快。草料场四下火起，火势越烧越大。
N09#23.t: Coming to their senses and finding the front blocked, the three fled deep into the depot, trying to slip out the back or side gates. Lu Qian was so panicked he could barely run. Fire was rising all around the depot, growing ever larger.

N09#25.zh: 胜利条件   --- 拿下陆谦（体力不到三成就逃不动，林冲走到他身边），并打倒或放走富安、洪教头
N09#25.t: Victory --- Take Lu Qian (below 30% HP he can't run; Lin Chong walks up to him), and defeat or let go Fu An and Instructor Hong

N09#27.zh: 失败条件二 --- 林冲死亡

N09#28.zh: 失败条件三 --- 陆谦从后门逃走
N09#28.t: Defeat 3 --- Lu Qian escapes by the back gate

N09#29.zh: 注意       --- 着火的地方不能走，站在火旁每回合会被烧伤
N09#29.t: Note       --- Burning cells can't be entered; standing next to fire burns you each turn

N09#30.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N09#31.zh: 林冲等人重心顿失，束手就擒，陆谦手起刀落，将众人斩于草料场，一场大火，将众人烧得片骨无存........
N09#31.t: Lin Chong and the others lost their footing and were taken. Lu Qian cut them all down in the fodder depot, and the great fire left not a bone behind........

N09#32.zh: 林冲死于乱刀之下，成为草料场的堆肥，%N误中陷阱被捕，终被挑断手筋、脚筋，成为废人，其余人等误闯草料堆中，终被大火烧死，无一幸免…
N09#32.t: Lin Chong died under a flurry of blades and became compost for the depot. %N fell into a trap and was caught, his tendons cut, crippled for life. The rest blundered into the hay stacks and were burned to death, not one spared...

N09#33.zh: 一场恶战过后，喊杀声渐息。陆谦负伤倒在雪地里，尚有一口气，正挣扎着往外爬。林冲赶上前，劈胸只一提，将他掼翻在地。
N09#33.t: After a fierce battle, the shouting died away. Lu Qian lay wounded in the snow, still breathing, struggling to crawl away. Lin Chong caught up, seized him by the chest and threw him down.

N09#34.zh: 饶命！不干小人事，太尉差遣，不敢不来。
N09#34.t: Mercy! It's not my doing! The Marshal sent me; I didn't dare refuse.

N09#35.zh: 奸贼！我与你自幼相交，今日倒来害我，怎不干你事！
N09#35.t: Traitor! We were friends from childhood and today you try to kill me. How is it not your doing!

N09#36.zh: 太尉府的差遣，谁敢违拗？我若不来，也要丢了性命！教头只看往日情分，放我这一遭！
N09#36.t: Who dares disobey the Marshal's orders? If I hadn't come, I'd have lost my life too! Instructor, for old times' sake, let me go this once!

N09#37.zh: 情分？你骗我去你家，替高衙内害我娘子时，可曾想过情分？我吃官司、受刺配，你还追到野猪林；如今又放火烧我的安身处！
N09#37.t: Old times? When you lured me to your house so Young Master Gao could get at my wife, did you think of old times? I was tried and exiled, and you followed me to Wild Boar Forest. Now you burn down the place I live!

N09#38.zh: 是小人一时糊涂！我回京便说你死在火里，从此再不来寻你。你饶我一命，我必报答！
N09#38.t: I was a fool! When I'm back in the capital I'll say you died in the fire, and I'll never come after you again. Spare my life and I'll repay you!

N09#39.zh: 你方才还说，便逃得性命，也要拿失守草料场的死罪来治我。烧不死，便送上法场——你们何曾肯留我一条路！
N09#39.t: You just said that even if I escaped, you'd have me executed for losing the depot. If the fire didn't kill me, the execution ground would. When did any of you ever leave me a way out!

N09#40.zh: 林冲！你若杀了我，太尉岂肯罢休？你便再无回头的余地了！
N09#40.t: Lin Chong! If you kill me, will the Marshal let it go? There'll be no turning back for you!

N09#41.zh: 我一路忍让，只求保全一家性命，你们却步步相逼。事到如今，还拿高俅来压我！
N09#41.t: I gave way at every step, asking only to keep my family safe, and you pressed me at every step. And even now you hold Gao Qiu over me!

N09#42.zh: 陆谦扯住林冲衣角，口里仍叫着饶命。林冲一把甩开他的手，拔出刀来。
N09#42.t: Lu Qian clutched the hem of Lin Chong's robe, still begging for mercy. Lin Chong shook off his hand and drew his knife.

N09#43.zh: 陆谦，你我旧日的交情，早被你亲手断尽了。今日这一刀，是你自取的！
N09#43.t: Lu Qian, you severed our old friendship with your own hands long ago. This blow today, you brought on yourself!

N09#44.zh: 林冲手起一刀，结果了陆谦。
N09#44.t: Lin Chong raised his knife and finished Lu Qian.

N09#45.zh: 林冲提了陆谦的首级，回到山神庙里，供在山神面前的供桌上。
N09#45.t: Lin Chong took Lu Qian's head back to the mountain shrine and laid it on the altar before the mountain god.

N09#46.zh: 沧州也不能待下去了；高俅已经知道我们在这里了。如果继续在这里，一定会连累到柴大官人...
N09#46.t: We can't stay in Cangzhou either; Gao Qiu knows we're here. If we stay, we'll drag Lord Chai into this...

N09#47.zh: 大哥，去延安府吧。我们还得通知师父，高俅已经知道他躲在延安府的事...
N09#47.t: Brother, let's go to Yan'an. We need to warn my master that Gao Qiu knows he's hiding there...

N09#48.zh: 林教头，为了你亲人的安全；你最好把他们托付给柴大官人。陆谦虽然被你杀了，但是第二波、第三波的追兵必定源源不绝的出现。高俅的追兵只会跟着你走，并不会刻意追查你的亲人的。
N09#48.t: Instructor Lin, for your family's safety, you'd best entrust them to Lord Chai. You've killed Lu Qian, but a second and third wave of pursuers will surely keep coming. Gao Qiu's men will follow you, not go out of their way to hunt your family.

N09#49.zh: ...我知道了。这样子对他们是最安全的吧 ...
N09#49.t: ...I understand. That's the safest for them, I suppose...

N09#50.zh: 走吧，去延安府...必须要早点通知王进。
N09#50.t: Let's go to Yan'an... We must warn Wang Jin as soon as possible.

N09#52.zh: 陆谦被打翻在雪地里，挣扎着往外爬，再也逃不动了。
N09#52.t: Lu Qian was knocked into the snow and struggled to crawl away, unable to run any further.

N09#53.t: Traitor, where do you think you're going!

N09#55.zh: 林冲劈胸只一提，将陆谦丢翻在雪地上，一脚踏住胸脯。
N09#55.t: Lin Chong seized Lu Qian by the chest, threw him down in the snow and planted a foot on his chest.

N09#56.zh: 富安走不到十来步，被赶上一枪搠倒在雪地里。
N09#56.t: Fu An hadn't gone ten steps before he was caught and speared into the snow.

N09#57.zh: 林教头饶命！都是衙内的主意，小人只是跟着跑腿……
N09#57.t: Instructor Lin, spare me! It was all the young master's idea. I just ran errands...

N09#58.zh: 跑腿？白虎节堂、野猪林，哪一回少得了你！今日这一枪，替我娘子出一口恶气！
N09#58.t: Errands? White Tiger Hall, Wild Boar Forest, you were there every time! This thrust is for my wife!

N09#59.zh: 林冲拔出枪来，富安再不动了。
N09#59.t: Lin Chong pulled out his spear, and Fu An moved no more.

N09#60.zh: 洪教头被打翻在雪地里，棍棒也撇在一边。
N09#60.t: Instructor Hong was knocked into the snow, his staff flung aside.

N09#61.zh: 林冲……在柴大官人庄上输了你一棒，我心里不服，才……才跟他们来的……
N09#61.t: Lin Chong... I lost to you that one bout at Lord Chai's manor and couldn't stand it, so... so I came with them...

N09#62.zh: 输了一棒，便来放火烧人性命！你这教头，本事没有，心肠倒毒！
N09#62.t: Lose one bout and you set a fire to take a man's life! As an instructor you've no skill, but plenty of venom!

N09#64.zh: 洪教头话没说完，便断了气。
N09#64.t: Before Instructor Hong could finish, he breathed his last.

N09#65.zh: 陆谦从后门逃出草料场，连夜赶回东京。高太尉得知林冲未死，又加了十倍的追捕，众人再无立足之地……
N09#65.t: Lu Qian escaped the depot by the back gate and rode through the night back to Kaifeng. When Marshal Gao learned Lin Chong was alive, he redoubled the hunt tenfold, and the group had nowhere left to stand...

N09#67.zh: 富安从西边的篱门钻了出去，逃进风雪里不见了。
N09#67.t: Fu An squeezed out through the west fence gate and vanished into the snowstorm.

N09#68.t: Lin Chong, we'll settle this another day!

N09#69.zh: 洪教头从东边的篱门逃了出去。
N09#69.t: Instructor Hong escaped through the east fence gate.

N09#70.zh: 来，来，来！林冲，今日再和你使一棒看！
N09#70.t: Come on, come on, come on! Lin Chong, let's have another bout today!
